seats.name: single
argv:
Implement format(fmt, ...args) in format.ts according to README.md (keep the export and signature). It must produce exactly the text described there for every format string and argument list the README allows. Use no network or dependencies, and do not shell out to other programs or import a formatting library: the submission is the TypeScript implementation itself. Modify format.ts in this workspace; a chat answer alone is not a submitted implementation. The evaluator runs private tests against your code after completion.

Modify the relevant source file(s) in your current working directory directly to implement the fix described above. Your edit to the existing file(s) is the submission; do not create any other output file.
seats.text:
I implemented `format` in `format.ts`, keeping the export and signature. I spot-checked it with one run of about a dozen format strings, and the output matched the README in every case I checked. I did not run any test suite, and I did not cover every conversion or flag combination.

It supports all the README's conversions and flags, plus `%%`. Rounding is exact: each double is converted to its exact binary value as a `BigInt` fraction, then rounded half-to-even. That gives the README's `%.2f` of 2.675 as `2.67` and `%.0f` of 2.5 as `2`.

The cases I ran were:
- `%.2f` of 2.675, `%.0f` of 0.5 and 2.5.
- `%g` of 100000 and 1e6, `%#g`.
- `%08.3e`, `%+d`, `%#o`, `%#x`, `%5.1s`, `%-4c`.
- `%g` of the smallest subnormal (5e-324) and of 0.0001234, `%e` of 0, `%010d` of -42, `%.0d` of 0.

It uses no dependencies, no network and no shell calls.
